abstract: McKinsey Global Institute projects that generative AI could automate activities representing up to 30% of current work hours by 2030. The research reveals significant disparities in labor market impacts, with lower-wage workers facing substantially higher rates of occupational transition compared to higher-wage workers, highlighting potential inequality in how AI-driven automation affects different worker segments.
keyFindings: Activities accounting for up to 30% of hours currently worked could be automated by 2030, accelerated by generative AI.
Lower-wage workers face up to 14x more occupational transitions than higher-wage counterparts.
qualifiers: Projections based on 'up to' 30% automation indicate uncertainty about the precise extent of AI-driven automation by 2030.
